personal_info.summary: Passionate Frontend Developer and IT Recruiter with extensive experience in diverse technologies. I excel in problem-solving and am committed to writing clean and efficient code. As a strong team player, I am eager to learn and contribute to dynamic projects. Additionally, my recruitment experience allows me to identify and attract exceptional talent, ensuring that teams are composed of the best professionals in the industry. I am dedicated to fostering a collaborative environment and driving growth for both projects and team talent.

responsibilities: Research and analyze IT profiles to identify and send highly qualified candidates from LATAM.
Develop, manage and maintain organized, up-to-date databases to optimize the recruitment process.
Schedule and conduct interviews, assessing not only technical skills but also cultural and professional fit.
Plan and execute effective strategies to attract talent for new openings, always aligning with market trends.
Maintain constant follow-up with candidates and stakeholders to ensure a smooth and effective selection process.
Act as an intermediary in negotiations, always seeking the best agreements that benefit both candidates and companies.
Maintain ongoing communication with clients to follow up on processes and remain available for new openings.
Lead the sourcing process, utilizing advanced tools and techniques to identify the best available talent.
Collaborate with companies fostering strong and lasting relationships in the sector.
Manage the site's content, design, and structure to ensure smooth navigation and optimal user experience.
Install, configure, and update plugins to add specific functionalities, ensuring compatibility and performance.
Monitor the server and site software to ensure proper functioning, performing preventive maintenance and troubleshooting as needed.
Implement tools to automate administrative tasks and customer service, improving operational efficiency.
Regularly upload and update relevant information, ensuring the site provides accurate and current content to visitors.
Sourcer and recruiter of candidates located in US territory.
Contact candidates via email or phone call.
Used multiple platforms for recruitment process.
Manage and update databases.
Product researcher and analyst for web applications and various software.
Product evaluation based on industry standards.
Writer of unbiased reviews based on critical thinking, focused on the operation and pragmatism of the application.
